description: 尼姆佐-印度 E47 — 黑格弱点链

intro.popup_en:
Weak Squares, Practice 9: A Chain of Light-Square Weaknesses
After Bxc3, White has lost the light-squared bishop. The squares d4, f4, and h4 can become a chain of light-square weaknesses. Use the surviving dark-squared bishop to target them with Bg5.
intro.popup:
黑格弱点链 练习9

Bxc3后白方失去白格象
d4+f4+h4构成白格弱点链

用存活的象攻对应颜色弱格—
Bg5！黑格象沿弱点链施压

outro.popup_en: Summary: Bxc3 creates light-square weaknesses; after ...exd4, White's center becomes doubled and d4 is another target. Bg5 places the dark-squared bishop on the diagonal to pressure the chain. When a bishop is exchanged, immediately inspect the squares of its color.
outro.popup:
弱点链练习小结
✅ Bxc3让白格弱点链产生
✅ exd4后白中心变叠兵
✅ Bg5象沿黑格斜线施压白格弱点

练习要点：
失去某颜色象→立刻检查对应弱格

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! The Nimzo-Indian bishop pins the knight.
e3 preserves both bishops in the Sämisch Variation.
moves.popup:
e3保留双象
塞米什变例

moves.popup_en: Ne2! White reroutes the knight to avoid blocking the c-pawn, preparing to recapture on c3 with the other knight if needed.
moves.popup:
Ne2！绕开叠兵路线
为cxd5后Nec3铺路

moves.popup_en: cxd5 exchanges pawns in the center.
...exd5 recaptures and leaves a central pawn structure to target.
a3 asks the bishop on b4 to decide whether to retreat or exchange.
...Bxc3! Black exchanges the bishop for the knight. White loses the light-squared bishop, creating a chain of light-square weaknesses on d4, f4, and h4.
moves.popup:
Bxc3！兑换！
白格象消失
白格弱点链产生：d4+f4+h4

moves.popup_en: Nxc3 recaptures with the knight. White has doubled c-pawns but retains central control.
moves.popup:
Nxc3马吃回
c3叠兵但控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 rebuilds Black's center, while White's pawns on e3 and d4 leave d4 as a target.
moves.popup:
exd4重建
白叠兵e3+d4，d4格又弱！

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 places a rook on the e-file.
Bg5! The dark-squared bishop targets the light-square weakness chain along the h6-c1 diagonal, including d4 and f4. This is how the bishop of the opposite color can exploit those weaknesses.
moves.popup:
Bg5！黑格象出击
沿h6-c1斜线控制弱格链
d4+f4全都在这条斜线上！
这就是弱点链的威力
